title: GraphTFactor: A graph-based approach for proteins transcription factor prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.40867v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Transcription factors (TFs) play an important role in regulating gene expression, making their identification a fundamental task in computational biology. In this work, we propose GraphTFactor, a novel end-to-end framework that models protein sequences as graphs and directly classifies transcription factors. By encoding sequences into graph structures, the proposed approach naturally handles variable-length inputs while preserving relevant relational information, without imposing length constraints. Experimental results show that GraphTFactor outperforms state-of-the-art methods on benchmark datasets, demonstrating the effectiveness of graph-based representations for TF prediction while providing interpretable insights into the sequence regions contributing to the model's predictions. translated_title: GraphTFactor：一种基于图的蛋白质转录因子预测方法
translated_abstract: 转录因子（TFs）在调控基因表达中发挥着重要作用，因此识别转录因子成为计算生物学中的一项基础任务。在本工作中，我们提出了GraphTFactor，这是一种新颖的端到端框架，它将蛋白质序列建模为图，并直接对转录因子进行分类。通过将序列编码为图结构，所提出的方法能够自然地处理可变长度的输入，同时保留相关的关联信息，而不施加长度限制。实验结果表明，GraphTFactor在基准数据集上优于最先进的方法，证明了基于图的表示方法在转录因子预测中的有效性，同时还提供了对模型预测所依据的序列区域的可解释性见解。为了支持可复现性和实际应用，我们发布了一个开源软件包和一个交互式网络应用程序，使用户能够轻松执行（原文此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出GraphTFactor，一种将蛋白质序列建模为图的端到端框架，在转录因子预测任务上超越了现有最先进方法，同时具备可解释性并提供开源工具和网络应用。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes GraphTFactor, an end-to-end framework that models protein sequences as graphs for transcription factor prediction, outperforming state-of-the-art methods while providing interpretability and open-source tools.
